name: gh-flow-skills
description: One-shot issue-to-PR composition skills — chain the atomic GitHub skills into a single run, on a reachable remote or a push-blocked one

plugins.name: gh-flow
plugins.description: Carry a GitHub issue all the way to a reviewed PR in one run. Four skills on two axes: the ordinary path, where the issue and the PR live on the same reachable remote, and the relay path, for a destination remote whose git push a proxy blocks.
